fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political coverage, including a proposal for a nightly radio "political clinic" to give candidates airtime and discussion of Miami Beach city council maneuvering involving the city manager, police appointments, and gambling enforcement. Reports and commentary address Florida’s special legislative session and opposition to a proposed sales tax (including publication of reader names from anti–sales tax coupons). A major editorial reprints and discusses an Atlanta Journal piece on Chattanooga’s municipally owned electric utility to argue for municipal acquisition and lower electric rates in Miami, with additional local columns, notices, and advertisements.
